name: Soko Dame! Nee-san
source:
Older sister took care of protagonist after their parents died. Then she disappeared for three years, and now suddenly comes back. But there is no trace of former gentle sister! She's selfish, dominating and does whatever she wants to do.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
父母去世后，一直是姐姐照顾主人公。后来，她一度失踪三年，如今却突然归来。然而，过去那个温柔的姐姐已经不见踪影！现在的她任性霸道，一切只按自己的心意行事。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
